Implementation complete and verified. Final summary:

## Files changed

| File | Lines | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/model/table.rs` (new) | 284 | `CellRef`, `TableCell<'a>`, `TableInfo<'a>`, `TableProblem`/`TableScan` (crate), `TableKinds`, `Doc::table_info`, `Doc::cell`, span/scope/header reads, document-order table lookup |
| `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/model/table/grid.rs` (new) | 294 | deterministic HTML placement engine (`scan_table`), overlap/rowspan/width/caption checks, slot budget |
| `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/model/validate.rs` | 240→293 | hooks grid validation into `Doc::validate`/`validate_block`, maps problems to `DocIssue` path+position (`table_issue`, `child_at`) |
| `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/model/mod.rs` | +3 | `pub(crate) mod table;`… actually `pub mod table;` + re-exports `CellRef, TableCell, TableInfo` |
| `crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/tables.rs` (new) | 298 | 3 tests covering the valid grid and every invalid case |

## Behaviors

- **API**: `Doc::table_info(&self, schema, table_index) -> Option<TableInfo<'_>>` (ordinal = document-order table count, `None` out of range / schema without tables), `Doc::cell(&self, schema, CellRef) -> Option<&Block>` (covered positions resolve to the origin cell), plus `TableInfo::{table_index, rows, columns, has_caption, caption, cells, is_truncated, cell, cell_ref}`.
- **Grid model**: auto-placement — each row fills its first free column, `colspan`/`rowspan` keep their rectangle (rowspans written into later rows so holes/overlaps are detectable), row width = occupied extent, columns = max width. Deterministic, no `HashMap`, no `unsafe`/`unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`, saturating arithmetic, no indexing.
- **Invariants** (stable codes, reported with child-index path + `Pos`): `I17` no rows, `I18` span < 1, `I19` unequal effective row widths, `I20` rowspan past last row, `I21` overlapping cells, `I22` invalid scope (scope on data cell; unknown value; `colgroup`/`rowgroup` without matching span), `I23` `headers` entry not naming a cell id in the same table, `I24` caption duplicated or not first.
- **Safety bound**: a table grid is capped at `MAX_GRID_SLOTS = 2^21`; exceeding it reports a new documented code `I25` (adversarial spans would otherwise allocate unboundedly) and `TableInfo::is_truncated()` tells consumers the summary is a prefix.

## Notes / deviations worth a decision

1. `table_info`/`cell` take `&Schema` (kind names must be resolved) — the sketch's `table_info(table_index)` alone cannot identify `table`/`table_row`.
2. I split the module into `table.rs` + `table/grid.rs` (same pattern as `chunks.rs` + `chunks/`): a single file was 567 lines, over the repo's hard 300-line gate (`scripts/check_file_length.sh`).
3. `I25` is one code beyond the `I17..I24` set, for the allocation bound above — say the word and I will drop both it and `is_truncated`.
4. Tests build cells as `block+` containers with a paragraph child, because `schema/full/nodes.rs` changed concurrently (`cell.content("block+")`, figure → `image_block`).

## Verification run

- `cargo clippy -p rich-editor-auy --lib --test tables --locked -- -D warnings` → clean.
- `cargo test -p rich-editor-auy --locked --test tables --test schema_full --test validation --test a11y` → 3 + 12 + 1 + 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p rich-editor-auy --no-deps --locked` → clean (fixed one private intra-doc link).
- `rustfmt --check` on all touched files → clean; all files ≤ 300 lines.

Workspace-wide `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` was still failing earlier in peer-owned files (`tests/step_attrs.rs:31` and `tests/step_mark_attrs.rs:12` `clippy::type_complexity`, `tests/step_mark_attrs.rs:58` `clippy::excessive_nesting`), not in anything above; one transient lib failure from a concurrent `model/measure.rs` edit disappeared on re-run.
